title: the Weeping Wood Rising
author: Petra Dravenmoor
blurb: Sable Sandoval, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
